questions.question: A builder needs 36 bags of cement at R95 a bag. Find the cost using a friendly number.
questions.expected_answer: 36 times 100 is 3 600. That is R5 too much for each of the 36 bags, which is 36 times 5, or 180. 3 600 minus 180 is 3 420, so the cement costs R3 420.

questions.question: Concrete is mixed 1 bucket of cement to 3 buckets of sand. How much sand is needed for 12 buckets of cement, and how many buckets of mix will there be?
questions.expected_answer: Multiply both parts of the ratio by 12 to get 12 buckets of cement to 36 buckets of sand. Altogether 12 plus 36 is 48 buckets of mix.

questions.question: Tomatoes cost R45 per kilogram. How much do 12 kg cost, and what does per kilogram tell you?
questions.expected_answer: Per kilogram means for each kilogram, so each of the 12 kilograms costs R45. 45 times 12 is 540, so 12 kg cost R540.
